postConditions: The actor has the figures their role is permitted to see, each carrying the time it was calculated, so a number quoted later can be dated.
Any figure that could not be calculated is shown as unavailable with a Retry, and is not represented as zero.

No school record is created, changed or deactivated. Every tile is a read.

businessRules.rule: The tile set is decided by role and enforced server-side. A tile the role may not see is never sent to the browser, so hiding it in the interface is not the mechanism.
A tile the role may not see is not rendered at all — never blank, greyed or zero. A zero is itself information, and showing one where permission is the reason is misleading.
Cash in hand, today's expenses and payables are visible to School Admin and Principal only. Accounts collects money but does not see the school's cash position.
Every figure is scoped to the branch and academic session held in the session, per branch-scope and academic-session-scope.
Every figure carries the timestamp of its calculation, so a number quoted in a meeting an hour later can be dated.
Figures refresh on the configured interval while the dashboard is open, and immediately when Refresh is selected.
Selecting a tile or a module figure opens the list it was calculated from, with the same filters applied, so the number can always be proved.
A closed academic session may be viewed. Its figures are calculated as at the session's close and the dashboard is marked historical, so live and historical numbers are not confused.
Where a figure cannot be calculated, that tile alone shows an error and offers Retry. It never shows zero, an estimate, or a figure from an earlier load, in place of an error.
A module dashboard shows only figures drawn from that module's own data, and within the actor's row scope. A Teacher's attendance figure covers their assigned classes, not the school.
A module with fewer than three meaningful figures opens on its primary list instead, because a dashboard of one number costs a click and returns nothing.
A quick link to a screen the role may not open is not rendered.

basicFlow.userAction: Signs in, or selects Dashboard in the sidebar.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Determines the role and branch scope from the session.
Selects the tiles that role is permitted to see. Tiles outside the permission are not included in the response at all.
Calculates each figure for the current branch and academic session, each with its own calculation timestamp.
Renders each tile as its figure becomes ready, with the timestamp beside it. A slow tile does not hold up the rest.
Opens the list the figure was calculated from, with the same filters applied.

basicFlow.userAction: Selects a module from the sidebar.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Checks the role may reach the module, then calculates that module's own figures within the actor's row scope.

basicFlow.navigation: Module dashboard → List or linked screen
basicFlow.userAction: Selects a figure or a quick link.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Opens the underlying list or the linked screen.

alternateFlows.condition: The actor switches branch in the header
alternateFlows.navigation: Main dashboard → Branch switcher → Main dashboard
alternateFlows.behaviour: Every figure recalculates for the newly selected branch and the timestamps reset. No figure from the previous branch remains on screen.

alternateFlows.condition: A closed academic session is selected
alternateFlows.navigation: Main dashboard → Session selector → Main dashboard
alternateFlows.behaviour: Figures are calculated as at the session's close and the dashboard is marked historical (BR-8).
Each tile renders as soon as its own figure is ready, per screen-states. A slow tile never holds up the rest of the dashboard.

alternateFlows.condition: The module has fewer than three meaningful figures
alternateFlows.behaviour: The module opens on its primary list instead of a dashboard (BR-11).

alternateFlows.condition: Arrived by drill-through from a main dashboard tile
alternateFlows.behaviour: The module dashboard opens with the originating filter already applied, so the context is not lost.

exceptions.systemResponse: That tile alone shows the error and offers Retry. Every other tile is unaffected (BR-9).

conventionsApplied.name: session-and-authentication
conventionsApplied.rule: Every use case except the login use case assumes an authenticated session. Sign out is available on every screen. An expired or invalid session returns the user to the login screen with the message "Your session has ended. Please sign in again."

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: money
conventionsApplied.rule: All monetary values are stored as fixed-point decimals in the smallest currency unit, never as floating point. Displayed as PKR with a thousands separator and two decimal places. Rounding is half-up at the line.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
